g.text: Sample elevation + land cover along transect (~1.5m spacing)
Order points west to east, reverse if needed for seaward→landward propagation
Classify segments by NLCD + depth → fetch or obstruction
Apply NAS Eq. 13 wave growth: Hf = √[(G·d)² + Hi²]
Derive crest elevation Z_w = S + 0.7H (NAS Eq. 1)
Render Chart.js datasets (ground, still water, crest, H_x, breaker)
Recompute wave series using stored transect
User may toggle layers or right-click to reset
